component.name: TurboStage
component.summary: Organize and play your DOS games

description.p: TurboStage is a friendly frontend for DOSBox Staging that turns your pile of DOS games into a ready-to-play library. Drop in your .zip or .iso files, and TurboStage handles detection, setup, sound configuration and launching. No command line, no config files.

ul.li: Cover-art grid library with search, game details, summaries and screenshots
Automatic detection of known games, with community-shared configurations
CD-ROM (ISO) games, including guided hard-drive installation
One-click Roland MT-32 and Sound Canvas (SC-55) music, selectable per game
Simple per-game CPU speed presets and advanced DOSBox options
Free downloadable games available straight from the library

description.p: DOSBox Staging is included. TurboStage does not include any commercial games; you need your own copies.
Game information and images are provided by IGDB.com.
